headline: Russia and Ukraine Agree to Prisoner Exchange
deck: The announced exchange followed Abu Dhabi’s second day; Medinsky said the sides found mutual understanding in some European-security areas.
body: Russia and Ukraine agreed to a large-scale prisoner exchange after the second day of trilateral talks in Abu Dhabi, Vladimir Medinsky, Russia’s negotiator, said. He did not disclose its size or timing. [E1]
The first day’s session lasted four hours and was followed by a scheduled second day; the announced exchange is the development since this paper’s prior coverage. [E4] [E1]
Medinsky said the European security system was the talks’ central topic and that the participants had found mutual understanding in some areas but not in others. [E2]
Territory remains the main obstacle, and American negotiators assess that the sides do not trust one another. [E3]
